What did HBO's 1975 satellite use enable?
Single satellite = national cable network; enabled all subsequent national cable channels
June 1, 1980; Ted Turner; 24-hour news; first channel of its kind
Direct Broadcast Satellite; small 18-inch dish; DirecTV 1994; Ku-band; enabled rural competition to cable
FCC rule: cable must carry local broadcast stations; protects local broadcast
Broadcasters' right to negotiate payment from cable for carriage (alternative to must-carry)
What did MTV do for record labels?
Music videos = free marketing content; labels supplied videos free; MTV drove record sales
Why did cable channels proliferate post-1979?
Satellite distribution eliminated geographic cost barrier; any channel could be national cheaply
